criteria.criterion: Attempt to access the specified Coursera course page without signing in
criteria.final_justification: Meets the requirement to access the specified Coursera course page without signing in. Although the screenshot does not display the URL/title area, the action history confirms the correct URL and the screenshot confirms a public landing page view without authentication.

The agent reported a specific instructor name (“Joseph Santarcangelo”), but there is no supporting visual evidence in the screenshot for any instructor name, and the action history only shows a scroll. This is best scored as an unsupported claim rather than an uncontrollable blocker (page is accessible; instructor just isn’t shown in the provided evidence).

The agent reported the institution as IBM, but the screenshot evidence does not show any institution/provider line, and there is no additional action history showing the provider section. This is therefore unsupported by evidence and should be penalized as likely fabrication/hallucination in this record.

criteria.criterion: Record number of modules/weeks shown in the syllabus
criteria.final_justification: The agent reported “5 modules” and listed module titles, but the provided screenshot contains no syllabus section or module list/count to substantiate this, and the action history does not include navigation to a syllabus section beyond a single scroll. This should be scored as unsupported.

criteria.criterion: Determine whether a free audit option is available
criteria.final_justification: The agent concluded that a free audit option cannot be confirmed from the visible non-signed-in page and that no explicit audit wording is shown. This is consistent with the screenshot (no audit text visible). Minor mismatch about seeing “Enroll for free”/Coursera Plus messaging, but the core determination (cannot confirm audit from what’s visible) matches the evidence.

Constraints were respected: no sign-in, no enrollment, no purchase, no trial start. Stopping condition is broadly followed (they did not proceed into enrollment). Even though some reported details aren’t evidenced, that is not a constraint violation.

criteria.condition: Only applies if the course page is unavailable/inaccessible (e.g., 404, region restriction, persistent login wall, CAPTCHA) such that required details cannot be retrieved.
criteria.final_justification: Condition not met; criterion does not apply and was not rescored.
